title: SDR daily scratchpad - 2026-03-08
content:
MORNING PLAN (8:30am)
- Quick sync w/ Jamie (8:45) - priorities + any hard-no lists
- Hit top 6 warm accounts first (sequence A)
- 11:00 demo prep with Noah (review deck + technical contact)

CALL LIST (priority order)
1) GreenLeaf Health (warm) - spoke last week. Ask: confirm demo date, can we get infra + security contact?
   - Last touch: 2026-03-02 voicemail, lead: Sarah Kim (Director IT)
   - SFDC: OPP-0045723 (deal stage: discovery)
   - Script: "Quick check-in, Sarah — wanted to confirm the demo for next Tue and see if you want security team on the call."
   - Next step: book security intro (action: send calendar invite + prep doc)

2) ParcelRight (cold -> engaged) - inbound MQL, high token use case (classification + summarization)
   - Lead: Marco Silva (CTO)
   - Note: concern about latency for short queries — bring up Redwood Dedicated + SLA
   - Template email snippet: "We can run a short perf test using your sample traffic to show latency/cost estimates."

3) MapleLaw (warm) - legal tech, needs private deployment info
   - Lead: Priya Desai (Head of Platform)
   - Action: send private-deploy one-pager + ask about compliance requirements (SOC2 + FedRAMP?)

FOLLOW-UPS & TASKS
- [ ] Send GreenLeaf security intro + demo invite (ASAP)
- [ ] Upload GreenLeaf sample prompts to shared folder (link to Confluence page in artifacts)
- [ ] Sequence B follow-up to ParcelRight (email + two-touch call)
- [ ] Add MapleLaw to Private deployment nurture sequence (tag in CRM)
- [ ] Log call notes for yesterday's 3 outbound dials (CRM)

NOTES / QUICK PITCHES
- Elevator: "Redwood gives predictable LLM inference — lower per-token costs with KV caching and automatic batching, plus private deployments for regulated teams."
- Objection: "We can self-host cheaper." 
  - Response: "Totally — many teams self-host but they trade off ops complexity, slower iteration, and variable performance. We offer Dedicated and Private so you get predictable latency + less ops burden."
- Technical ask checklist for demos: "expected qps, avg seq len, typical concurrency, data residency needs, security contacts"

MEETING PREP / DATES
- Demo: GreenLeaf - target Tue 2026-03-10 10am PT (tentative)
- Internal: Demo dry-run with Noah - 2026-03-08 11:00am PT (30m)

LEADS TO PROSPECT (notes)
- ACME Logistics: revisit sequence after new pricing rollout (wait 2 weeks)
- FinTechCo: legal + compliance heavy — escalate to solutions-engineering for technical write-up

TO SELF (notes to self)
- Keep outreach concise — mention cost per 1k tokens when relevant (have numbers ready)
- Follow up on batch metrics doc with DevRel for examples
- Add 2 new vertical case studies to email template (healthcare, fintech)

OPEN QUESTIONS / RISKS
- Do we have an up-to-date Private deployment one-pager with KMS/HSM details? (if not, ping product security)
- Who owns the sandbox demo creds for Dedicated in APAC region? (ask SRE)

END OF DAY CHECK (placeholder)
- Log outcomes here after calls: short notes + next step (email / task / schedule follow-up)
